checks.statement: Adapt menu placement and layout to available window size while keeping the trigger relationship clear.
checks.condition: When window dimensions change.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Adaptive design: Adapt menu placement and layout to available window size while keeping the trigger relationship clear.

evidence.result: The runtime positions the main menu below its trigger, flips it above when it would exceed innerHeight, clamps left/top to viewport bounds, and CSS constrains width/height while enabling overflow scrolling.

implementation.notes: The menu placement path preserves trigger-relative placement and clamps the panel to the viewport; CSS constrains the panel to the available viewport and scrolls overflowing content.

checks.statement: Associate context-menu actions with the specific selected object or text.
checks.condition: When showing a context menu.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Context menus: Associate context-menu actions with the specific selected object or text.

evidence.result: The cited specimen is a standalone web example; it contains no application screen/navigation policy that can enforce this condition: “When showing a context menu.”.

implementation.notes: The condition is “When showing a context menu.” and the instruction is “Associate context-menu actions with the specific selected object or text.”. This is an app-level content, layout, or product-selection decision; the standalone reusable control/specimen does not have the surrounding screen context needed to apply it. This disposition covers this exact condition only.

checks.statement: For the baseline menu, keep width between 112dp and 280dp, 4dp corner radius, 48dp item height, 12dp horizontal and internal item spacing, 8dp divider vertical padding, 1dp divider height, and 24dp leading/trailing icons. Align labels vertically centered and horizontally to start.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Measurements prose or table: For the baseline menu, keep width between 112dp and 280dp, 4dp corner radius, 48dp item height, 12dp

evidence.result: Baseline CSS sets minimum width 112px, maximum 280px, zero expressive group gap, tokenized vertical padding, 48dp tokenized item height and tokenized horizontal/item spacing; item geometry is consumed directly from menu tokens.

implementation.notes: The baseline variant has the source width bounds and uses the captured measurement variables for item height, spacing, divider and padding. The token values remain those provided by Material input data.

checks.statement: Keep a menu item visible but disabled when it can be used only under specific conditions.
checks.condition: When a menu action is temporarily unavailable.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated the explicit Menu items rule: Keep a menu item visible but disabled when it can be used only under specific conditions.

evidence.result: The disabled preview state leaves its menu item rendered with aria-disabled=true; the roving menu item list retains aria-disabled entries, while click selection explicitly returns for aria-disabled=true.

implementation.notes: The implementation keeps the conditional item visible, allows it into menu focus management, and prevents its action from being selected.

checks.statement: Do not apply density changes by default if they compromise menu targets or legibility.
checks.condition: When offering dense menu layouts.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Density: Do not apply density changes by default if they compromise menu targets or legibility.

evidence.result: The menu preview has no density control or density attribute; baseline item geometry uses the standard tokenized padding/spacing, with no smaller-density override selected by default.

implementation.notes: The default web example applies the standard dimensions and does not activate a density reduction; user-selectable density changes are not exposed.

checks.statement: Match each menu item accessibility label to its visible text. On web, expose the role as Menu item; Android Views and Jetpack Compose use a generic actionable-element role.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from Labeling elements: Expose menu items with names and roles that describe their actions.

evidence.result: MenuPanel sets role=menu and a name; ordinary items use role=menuitem; selectable items use menuitemcheckbox/menuitemradio with aria-checked; icon-only items receive a text aria-label; visible text items keep their visible label.

implementation.notes: Web role and naming are assigned by the rendered menu helpers. The Android/Compose role mappings in the source do not apply to this web path.

checks.statement: On open, focus the first menu item. Allow exit by selecting an option, pressing Escape, tapping outside, or using system Back; focus placement after close depends on the app.

implementation.notes: The normal placement is next to the parent item with viewport-aware side flipping; the constrained-width fallback replaces the parent menu view, avoiding simultaneous overlap with that item.

checks.statement: For menus, Tab focuses the menu; Space/Enter opens a closed menu or submenu and selects an item in an open menu; Up/Down opens a closed menu or moves to the next item when open; Left/Right opens or closes submenus; typing a letter moves focus to the next item beginning with it; Escape closes the menu.

evidence.result: The keyboard item list excludes native disabled controls, while click handling rejects aria-disabled items; the specimen marks icon spans aria-hidden. Dividers/gaps are not menuitem elements.

implementation.notes: The implementation does not include native disabled items in roving focus (contrary to the source allowance that they may receive focus), though it prevents their selection. Decorative icons and divider roles are established; focus behavior needs a targeted disabled-item probe.

checks.statement: When a menu item has both text and an icon, mark the icon’s accessibility label decorative to avoid duplicate screen-reader output.
checks.condition: For menu items with text and an icon.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated the explicit Labeling elements instruction for decorative icons.

evidence.result: Icons inside text menu items are wrapped with aria-hidden=true, and icon-only menu items receive a text aria-label in menus.go.

implementation.notes: For items with visible text, the SVG icon is hidden from accessibility APIs, preventing duplicate naming; icon-only items instead receive an explicit action name.
